faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper (AWH) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the Anganwadi Helper (AWH) posts under WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026 is 28 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper (AWH) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Anganwadi Helper (AWH) posts in the Women and Child Development Department Odisha Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper (AWH) Recruitment 2026 is online. Candidates need to visit the official website to submit their applications.

faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Anganwadi Helper (AWH) positions must have passed 10+2 (Intermediate) from a recognized board or institution.

faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper (AWH) Recruitment 2026.

faq.answer: The selection process for Anganwadi Helper (AWH) includes online application submission, followed by document verification, and finally, a merit list will be prepared.
